name: Ceremonial Spur
descriptionTemplate: At turn start and after releasing Exalt, gain 1 stack of {Sprint}. After every 2 Posses unleashed, convert {Sprint} into {Rush Headlong}. When {Rush Headlong} reaches 16 stacks for the first time, remove {Rush Headlong} and gain {Charge unto Glory}.
lore: A symbol of knighthood, gilded in gold and bestowed by the king. Yet as a mere squire, he was granted only a pair of silver spurs. As for the gilded promise... that hope was severed long ago.
